milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The gray terracotta structure center is at approximately [0, 2, 12] spawn-relative (the 5x5x5 tower). max_distance is set to 5 to require the player to actually walk from spawn (~10 blocks away) up to the structure, rather than being auto-satisfied at spawn. facing_tolerance of 60° ensures the player is looking at the structure when they arrive.

Uses inventory_has because mining granite with a wooden pickaxe drops the granite block as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no granite in inventory, so any granite present confirms successful mining. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a stone_axe on the crafting table places it into the player's inventory. The player starts with 3 cobblestone + 2 sticks (exact recipe) and no stone_axe, so its presence confirms successful crafting. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks.
